title: Indian Vegetables Recipe
summary: The sound of mustard seeds popping in hot oil instantly take me back to my parents' kitchen growing up. I make this quick Indian vegetable recipe, or sabji with mixed vegetables, cumin seeds, and turm…
ingredients: ⅙ tsp cayenne pepper (or ½ of a green chili if you have one)
1½ cups Frozen Veggies (I like Trader Joe's Organic Foursome veggie medley)
steps: Heat olive oil over medium/high heat – and add mustard & cumin seeds. Let them fry in the oil until they “pop” (you’ll hear the popping/sizzling noise)
Once they pop, add the hing, turmeric, cayenne (or green chile)

Stir the spices, and then add the veggies. Stir the veggies until the spices are evenly incorporated. Let the veggies cook, continually stirring for about 10 minutes. Add salt to taste in the last minute or so of cooking.
Serve with roti, daal and/or spiced yogurt.
